verdict.rationale: Shortwave documents migration guides from Gmail, Spark and Superhuman, plus an 'import full history' how-to. By default it imports only the last 90 days of email, and community reports say free-plan users get no history beyond 90 days. A hands-on user confirmed aliases and signatures carried over, but the product works only with Gmail, so it cannot pull mail from non-Gmail providers. Missing for 10: evidence of contact import, documented full-history import that is not gated by plan, support for non-Gmail/IMAP providers, and independent confirmation that a complete history import works.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can import my complete mail history and contacts from my old provider or client
